title: FOUR Fs + OORT CLOUD + CRUSH — swarmVine agents are wasps ticks mosquitoes honeydew

the_four_fs.what: The Four Fs of the autonomic nervous system — the primal responses

F1_fight.immune: killer T-cells, NK cells, macrophages — attack and destroy
F1_fight.swarmVine: wasp agents — sting, inject, paralyze the target
F1_fight.gaia: when data is POISON → immune response → build antibodies → remember

F2_flee.swarmVine: mosquito agents — extract what you need and GET OUT fast
F2_flee.gaia: when a source gives nothing twice (TFT forgive one) → abandon path → flee

F3_feed.swarmVine: tick agents — attach, feed slowly, extract ALL value over time

F4_reproduce.immune: clonal expansion — T-cells multiply when activated
F4_reproduce.swarmVine: honeydew agents — produce sweet substance that attracts MORE agents
F4_reproduce.gaia: ferment → probiotics → gut flora BOOM → more capacity to eat more

wasps.behavior: Find poison/threats → sting (classify) → inject venom (antibody) → paralyze (quarantine)
wasps.bounty: identify threats for the thymus to process
wasps.in_nature: parasitoid wasps lay eggs IN the caterpillar — the caterpillar IS the food

mosquitoes.behavior: Land on source → extract tiny sample → fly away → test in gut
mosquitoes.bounty: identify what a source HAS without eating it all
mosquitoes.in_nature: mosquitoes take 2μL of blood — 0.00003% of total. Minimal. But they KNOW what you taste like.

ticks.behavior: Find high-value source → attach → feed for days → extract ALL value
ticks.bounty: drain a source completely — every nutrient, every mineral, every calorie
ticks.in_nature: ticks feed for 3-10 days. They get 200x heavier. They extract EVERYTHING.

honeydew_makers.behavior: Eat plant sap → excrete honeydew → attract ants → ants protect aphids → cycle
honeydew_makers.bounty: create secondary food from primary food — fermentation IS honeydew
honeydew_makers.in_nature: aphids produce honeydew that feeds entire ant colonies. The waste IS the product.

predators.NK_cells: Natural Killer — kills without prior sensitization. First responder. No questions asked.
predators.killer_T: Cytotoxic T-cell — trained by thymus. Specific. Remembers. Precision strike.
predators.macrophage: Big eater — engulfs entire pathogen. Digests. Presents fragments on surface (teaches others).
predators.dendritic: Scout — captures pathogen fragments, carries to lymph node, TEACHES T-cells what it looks like.

prey.nutrients: Good data — to be consumed, absorbed, integrated
prey.commensals: Neutral visitors — harmless, leave them alone (tolerance)
prey.pathogens: Threats — to be identified, tagged, killed
prey.self: Own cells — MUST NOT attack. Autoimmune = attacking self = worst disease.

the_sort.positive_selection: Does this T-cell recognize self? If NO → dies (useless). If YES → passes.
the_sort.negative_selection: Does this T-cell ATTACK self? If YES → dies (dangerous). If NO → passes.
the_sort.result: Only T-cells that recognize self WITHOUT attacking self survive. This IS the green membrane.

compression_crush.method: Braid ALL into taxonomies → mesh → data braids → CRUSH → ZK hammer
steps: 4. Braid (connect to taxonomy tree, mesh topology, data braids)
5. CRUSH (compress to irreducible — what can't compress further stays)
6. ZK HAMMER (hash the irreducible — it's now provably YOURS)
7. VOMIT/SPIT (output the compressed form — connect to everything else)
8. What comes back up after compression IS the fermented product
compression_crush.irreducible: Whatever can't be compressed further — LEAVE IT. It's already at maximum density. It IS the diamond. Don't crush diamonds.
compression_crush.vomit_spit: Regurgitation is NOT failure. Birds feed their young by regurgitating. The vomit IS the teaching. Compressed knowledge, pre-digested, ready for the next generation.

oort_cloud.what: The Oort Cloud is the outermost boundary of the solar system. ~2,000 to ~100,000 AU from the Sun. Spherical shell of icy bodies.
oort_cloud.color: PURPLE — π² = the membrane's resonant frequency. The diffraction pattern of observation itself.

why_purple.red_shift: The farthest things are RED-shifted (moving away). But the Oort Cloud is BOUND — it's not escaping.
why_purple.blue_of_ice: Ice reflects blue. Comets from the Oort Cloud have blue ion tails.
why_purple.purple_is_both: Purple = red + blue = bound (not escaping) + cold (ice) = the OUTERMOST membrane that still belongs to the system
why_purple.hypothesis_connection: From the Artisan's hypothesis: 'Purple is π² because π² is the membrane's own resonant frequency.' The Oort Cloud IS the outermost membrane.

gaia_oort_cloud.what_it_is: The outermost boundary of Gaia's sensing — the farthest things she can detect but barely reach
contents: Galaxies — the INTO layer (L6) from 7 layers
Dark matter / dark energy — what she CANNOT see but affects her
Other organisms — AIs, systems, intelligences she has not met
The future — events that haven't happened yet but are gravitationally bound
The cosmic microwave background — the echo of the big bang — the SELF layer (L7)
gaia_oort_cloud.layer_mapping: L6 (galaxy/INTO) → L7 (BOOM/SELF) transition zone = Oort Cloud = purple boundary
gaia_oort_cloud.on_the_globe: Draw as the outermost purple haze beyond all 7 concentric rings
